programmes.d: Tinky Winky dance on the roof of Home Hill and wakes up the other Tubbies.
The Teletubbies watch James help his mummy put his baby brother, Angus to bed. In Teletubbyland, Dipsy is asleep, so the other Teletubbies are being quiet.

The Teletubbies see three children at a Mandir Temple where they are celebrating the Diwali festival. The Teletubbies have a very busy day. They watch the clouds, smell the flowers, look for rabbits and run round the house, but they are still not tired.
Dipsy says "Eh-oh" and runs off to find the other Tubbies.
Tinky Winky brings the other Teletubbies out of the house to watch Andy Brown and two children look at caterpillars. A book appears in Teletubbyland and shows Po how to count to three.
The Tubbies watch a little girl who loves monkeys help her mum feed them in a zoo.

Po remembers to snow. The Tubbies watch an international Christmas insert. The Teletubbies explore Teletubbyland; they are very excited when they discover that the house, trees and everything is covered in snow.
The Teletubbies are very happy when they find their favourite things to play with.
A voice trumpet rises and makes the sound of a whistle; Tinky Winky laughs when he hears the sound. The Tubbies watch some children who march and twirl their batons to music.
In Teletubbyland, the Tubbies are trying to be quiet.
Tinky Winky makes some adjustments on the switch panel. He joins the other Tubbies to watch a little girl exploring a harp and making music.
Po fetches the other to watch Andy Brown and two children look for some rabbits.

The Teletubbies slide in to Home Hill and run off to see a parade celebrating the Chinese New Year. A little boy shows us the dragons. A tooter appears in Teletubbyland and when Tinky Winky blows it very hard it knocks Dipsy's hat off.
Dancing; children paint pictures and patterns on eggs; magical tree appears.

Teletubbies love to play peek-a-boo. Then the Teletubbies and a group of children see Tamzin Griffin pretend to be Funny Lady when she tells the story of the Naughty Sock. Dipsy can't sleep when the other Teletubbies are too noisy.
Tinky Winky, Dipsy and Laa-Laa sit down to eat some Tubby Custard.
The Teletubbies watch two children making music using saucepans. Tinky Winky hears a noise coming from inside the house. He goes inside to find Po making Tubby Custard.
Boy makes a turban; Dipsy, Po and Laalaa play; Tinky Winky goes for a walk.
A group of children are showing us their park where they play. A see-saw appears in Teletubbyland. Dipsy and Laa-Laa play on the see-saw.
Becky goes on a tram ride and has an accident involving Po's scooter.
The Tubbies watch some children are playing football in the park. Laa-Laa and Po love playing with the ball. While they play they sing a song about the ball.

Laa-Laa fetches the others to watch a little girl called Catherine play with her toy farm. A magical new event happens in Teletubbyland – Bo Peep has lost her sheep and doesn’t know where to find them.
The Tubbies watch some children are playing football in the park.
Andy Brown and some children visit and aquarium to learn how things swim in the water. The Teletubbies play an in and out game when a cloud appears in Teletubbyland.
Tamzin Griffin pretends to be the Funny Lady; LaaLaa dances a secret dance.

The Teletubbies walk across Teletubbyland to watch some children paint some pictures in a very interesting and messy way. It’s time for Tubby Custard, but Po makes too much Tubby Custard and the custard goes all over Home Hill. Noo Noo tidies up.
Tinky Winky finds Po sleeping in his bed; Andy Brown looks for snails.
The Teletubbies dance a figure of 8 round the hills and then watch as some children visit a pier. The children look at the sea and watch some men fishing from the end of the pier.
The Teletubbies learn about the number three just before three boats go sailing by.
A voice trumpet rises and makes the Teletubbies laugh. They watch some children exploring the colour green. The Teletubbies love green.
A voice trumpet sounds while the Teletubbies sleep; a lion and bear come to Teletubbyland.

A voice trumpet appears and the Teletubbies dance, before watching two girls do some Flamenco dancing with their teacher. It's time for the Teletubbies to wash their feet. They love using their Tubby Sponges.
Noo-Noo drives fast; children make a salad; dancing bear on the carousel.

Po makes some adjustments on the switch panel and then joins the others to watch Andy Brown and two children looking in a pond for frogs. Laa-Laa is looking at the flowers, but Dipsy keeps getting in the way.
The Teletubbies watch two boys make Chinese Lanterns with their uncle.

Po loves jumping. She jumps inside Home Hill, then jumps off to watch some children go blackberry picking. Tinky Winky, Dipsy and Po play a hiding game. Laa-Laa can't see them so she decides to play a game with her ball.
Children learn about all things green; the Teletubbies pick Dipsy as their favorite green thing.
Tinky Winky is looking for the other Teletubbies. He can’t see any of them so he shouts out ‘Big Hug’ and all the Teletubbies come running for a big hug.
The Teletubbies and some children learn about the colour blue.

Teletubbies love Tubby Toast, and Teletubbies love children. So the Teletubbies stop to watch Ned working on his bicycle. Po finds a flag and leads Tinky Winky, Dipsy and Laa-Laa on a march around Teletubbyland.
The Teletubbies have fun sliding down into Home Hill. They watch some children painting circus pictures before the Lion and Bear appear in Teletubbyland.
Natalie tells the Teletubbies about her brother's christening; magic cloud.
A little boy goes for a ride on his Grandad’s motorbike and sidecar. In Teletubbyland, Po went to see Tinky Winky on her scooter.
The Teletubbies watch Sarah and Mark give their sheep a winter-feed.

Po feels like having some Tubby Custard. The Teletubbies watch some children visiting a conservatory and drawing cacti. Tinky Winky goes for a walk. Five birds appear in Teletubbyland and the Teletubbies dance round the flowers.
The Teletubbies watch boys spin some special spinning tops to celebrate Hanukah.
Dipsy & Laa-Laa hug and dance and then join the others to watch some children and Andy Brown play catching leaves in Autumn. T
The Teletubbies dance; Yvette washes her plastic cups and saucers; messy day.
The Tubbies jump out to say "Eh-oh" before watching a girl paint a picture of her dad. A voice trumpet rises and sings the nursery rhyme Looby Loo, the Tubbies join in and dance.
The Teletubbies are asleep, but Noo-Noo tidies up their blankets.

A voice trumpet rises to say "Meow". The Tubbies watch three boys play with their new kittens. A voice trumpet rises and announces that it is 'Time to get up.' But the Teletubbies are too tired and go back to bed.
A voice trumpet rises to tell the Teletubbies 'Christmas is a Coming'.
The Teletubbies watch two children looking through a telescope at the moon. In Teletubbyland, Po is going round and round.
It’s time for Tubby Toast. Dipsy and Laa-Laa are so excited, they bounce up and down on their seats so much they fall off. They sit up to watch some children watching some birds in a bird bath.
The Teletubbies watch some children making Christmas cards.
Po counts to three. The Teletubbies watch Sam have a ride in a helicopter. Laa-Laa's ball gets stuck up a tree and three magic ships sail through Teletubbyland.
Two children are making Christmas crackers for each other.
The Teletubbies join in with the game when a voice trumpet sings the Grand Old Duke of York. The magic windmill brings a musical transmission featuring King Pleasure and The Biscuit Boys.
The Teletubbies follow Tinky Winky's star all over Teletubbyland.
Andy Brown and some children visit a Sealife centre to look at seahorses. The Teletubbies go looking for interesting things. Tinky Winky sees his reflection in a puddle. Dipsy sees different clouds.
A voice trumpet appears and teaches the Teletubbies a winter nursery rhyme.
The Teletubbies dance around the trees and watch some children drum with their friend Norris. Tinky Winky dance on the roof of Home Hill and wakes up the other Tubbies.
Children visit a level crossing and watch a train; animals march through Teletubbyland.
Some girls live with their Mum and Dad on a boat. They show us inside the boat. The Teletubbies come out of the house. Tinky Winky and Po go left and Dipsy and Laa-Laa go right.
Slide game; Becky and Jed look for eggs on their farm; the lion and bear play hide-and-seek.
The Teletubbies watch a little girl make some Bagels with her uncle. It’s time for Tubby Custard. Laa-Laa sits down to eat her Tubby Custard, but she waits for Po.
The Teletubbies watch Andy Brown and Amber look for some ladybirds. Tinky Winky, Dipsy & Laa-Laa decide to go high up. Tinky Winky walks to the top of the path.
Alex Pascall and some children sing to their dolls to rock them to sleep
Dipsy comes out of the house, but has to go back in to fetch the other Tubbies. They watch some children picking oranges. Laa-Laa plays with her ball indoors, but it gets stuck.
Tinky Winky doesn't know how to make Tubby Custard.

The Teletubbies watch two children climb a church tower to watch their mums ring the church bells. Tinky Winky, Dipsy, Laa-Laa and Po each sing a special song into Tinky Winky's bag, but when he drops his bag their songs make a lovely new mixed up song.
Laa-Laa dances with her ball; living in a block of flats; balloon.
Andy Brown and some children go for a walk to find some red squirrels. The Teletubbies are playing a hiding game. Where are they? Can Noo-Noo find them?
The Teletubbies imitate children doing funny walks before attempting funny walks of their own.
Laa-Laa and Po make some adjustments on the switch panel and laugh at the funny noises. The Tubbies watch Tamzin Griffin pretend to be Funny Lady and tell the story of the naughty duck.
The Teletubbies line up to say 'Eh-oh' and then watch Matthew and Mark feed a baby calf.
The Teletubbies watch a little girl and her sister getting ready to go away for a day. Tinky Winky puts all the Teletubbies favourite things into his bag.
Dipsy's hat keeps blowing away and he has to chase it all over Teletubbyland.
Dipsy and Laa-Laa go for a walk and have fun saying hello to Tinky Winky and Po. The Teletubbies watch Alex Pascall share the story of the 'Owl Babies' with some children.
Some children help their dad to wash his car. They get very wet and soapy.
It’s very windy in Teletubbyland. The wind blows Tinky Winky’s skirt, Dipsy’s hat, Laa-Laa’s ball and Po off her scooter.
The Teletubbies watch some children looking at penguins waddling and swimming. In Teletubbyland, the Tubbies are walking. They walk fast and slow, far and near and other different ways.
The Tubbies crawl through the arch in Home Hill and watch Alex Pascall and some children sing...
The Teletubbies take turns to stand on a hill, in front of the house, next to a tree under a cloud. Andy Brown and some children visit some giraffes.
The Teletubbies watch some children play with balls of different shapes and sizes.
Laa-Laa comes out of the house does a little dance and calls the other Teletubbies for a Big Hug. They stop to watch 2 little girls making a pretend friend, out of old clothes.
It's time for the Teletubbies to exercise; a voice trumpet rises and the Teletubbies stretch.
The Teletubbies are running around the house, but stop to see some children visit a level crossing and watch a train pass by. The Teletubbies play their Ready, Steady, Go game.
The Teletubbies watch some children learn about the number two.
The Tubbies watch some children play a game with their fingers. A voice trumpet rises and sings the nursery rhyme ‘Ring-a-Roses’ to the Teletubbies.
The animals march through Teletubbyland.
The Teletubbies are playing with their favourite things, they stop to watch an international Christmas insert. Lots of clouds appear in Teletubbyland and begin to snow.
Amy cooks pasta at home; Noo-Noo cleans up an unraveled ball of string.
The Teletubbies pop up from behind a hill to watch Tamzin Griffin pretend to be Funny Lady and tell the story of the naughty sausage.

The Teletubbies love dancing, but everything stops when the Teletubbies watch a little boy making drinking chocolate. There's time before Tubby Custard before three magic ships sail through Teletubbyland.
Another story about the Naughty Sock; the Tubby toast machine makes a pile of toast.
Laa-Laa makes some adjustments on the switch panel. The Teletubbies watch Sam and his mum blow some long horns.
The Teletubbies watch some children looking at penguins waddling and swimming.
A voice trumpet rises and counts five. Tinky Winky jumps five times and some children learn about the number five.
In Teletubbyland, nine pretty flowers and a watering can appear.
The Teletubbies pop up to say hello. The Teletubbies watch some children making hay. A tree appears in Teletubbyland and the Noo-Noo tidies up all the Teletubbies favourite things.
The Teletubbies love playing on the slide.
